method: Reopened all five public Wix detail pages and the overview; compared live text, source figures, current summary and DETAIL content.
findings: Earlier editorial summaries omitted substantive concepts, objectives and applications. The previous verification file contained abbreviated editorial prose rather than a full transcription.
restoration: Visible summaries and focus terms retain key objectives. DETAIL paragraphs cover mechanisms, controls and applications; all eleven source figures are available in their original page order.
scope: Content restoration only; no new publication links or completed experimental results are asserted. Absolute promotional or historical novelty claims are not repeated as current facts.

topics.title: Quantum light sources
